spec.description: Time-series view of the CPU and memory requests committed per cluster, product, project and namespace.

spec.title: CPU requests vs capacity, by cluster
spec.description: Requests committed on each cluster, against its allocatable capacity (dashed). Capacity is cluster-wide and is NOT affected by the product / project / namespace filters, so filtering lowers requests while the ceiling stays put.

spec.expr:
sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  ${agg}_over_time(namespace_cpu:kube_pod_container_resource_requests:sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__interval])
)

spec.title: CPU requests by product
spec.description: Requests rolled up per product label on the namespace. Namespaces carrying no product / project label are grouped under "(none)".

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  sum by (label_product) (
    clamp_max(
      topk(1,
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
        or
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
      ) by (cluster, namespace)
      , 1)
    * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
    ${agg}_over_time(namespace_cpu:kube_pod_container_resource_requests:sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__interval])
  ),
  "label_product", "(none)", "label_product", "^$"
)

spec.name: agg
spec.label: Aggregation
spec.description: How each bucket is reduced: avg for the cost-weighted trend, max for the peak reservation.

spec.name: max_shown
spec.label: Max projects / namespaces shown
spec.description: How many projects, or namespaces, the two lower charts draw — the biggest first. There are around 700 namespaces across the fleet, so they have to be capped.
